en.sayed-ali-raza: Allāh sent Muḥammad (s.a.w.) as a warner (against vice) for all the worlds and a trustee of His revelation,
while you people of Arabia were following the worst religion and you resided among rough stones and venomous serpents.
You drank dirty water and ate filthy food. You shed blood of each other and cared not for relationship.
Idols are fixed among you and sins are clinging to you.
